name: Milkyway
source:
Fed up with your lazy attitude, your parents depart on travel for an indefinite amount of time, leaving you with the responsibility of taking care of the family kissaten and your little sister. With the help of your childhood friend, you rearrange the shop, and hire new people, hoping to avoid bankruptcy.

[from[url=http://renai.gwathyr.net/pictures/RAML/] this site[/url]]
translation:
父母受夠了你的懶散態度，出門旅行，連什麼時候回來都沒說，把照顧家庭咖啡館和妹妹的責任留給了你。在青梅竹馬的幫助下，你重新佈置店鋪、僱用新員工，希望避免破產。

[摘自[url=http://renai.gwathyr.net/pictures/RAML/]此網站[/url]]
